issues.description: The problem statement (UML) specifies numberOfLecturers as type int, but the solution implementation declares the field numberOfLecturers as byte and provides a setter that accepts a byte while the getter returns int. This creates an inconsistency between the specified attribute type in the UML/problem and the solution code, and also a mismatch between the field type and its accessor signatures which can confuse students about the intended type.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the attribute type for numberOfLecturers across all artifacts. Prefer changing the solution to declare numberOfLecturers as int (and update the setter parameter to int) to match the UML/problem statement. Alternatively, if byte is intentional, update the UML/problem text to state byte and make the getter and setter consistently use byte.
